$schema_comment: Bambu Lab A1 Mini print-time estimator. 3MF is not printable until sliced — the app uses these params to synthesize an estimated G-code path and time.

timeModel.comment: extrudedVolume from walls+infill+skins; time = max(volume/flow, pathLength/avgSpeed) + layers*overhead, then *overheadFactor *scaleFactor

calibration.referenceLabel: MoonLamp v2.2 full kit (~35 cm moon + parts)
notes: Ground truth: full MoonLamp print takes ~39.9 h with all parts (user / listing).
Mesh metrics measured from 3D/Objects/*.model inside the 3MF (sum of closed volumes).
Embedded project_settings in the 3MF are P1S 0.4 nozzle / 0.16 mm / 2 walls — NOT used.
This profile targets A1 Mini 0.2 nozzle, 0.1 mm layer, 4 walls, 15% infill.
Estimates are relative; regenerate after changing JSON (scaleFactor, speeds, walls, etc).
